caption: The drawing features three small, detailed illustrations arranged horizontally in the center of a plain, beige background. The object in the middle is a colored depiction of a ring with a gold band and several prominent dark stones or gems set into it, forming an intricate, symmetrical design. On either side of the central ring are two objects drawn in gray pencil or ink: the one on the left depicts a top view of an ornate ring setting or bezel, while the one on the right shows a side view of the same or a similar ring, highlighting the design from a different angle. The bottom right corner of the drawing contains the signature "M. Fenda." The rest of the page is kept blank, focusing attention on the three central objects.
title: Memorial Ring
